benefits: Rs 6,000 per year to each eligible landholding farmer family, paid as 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank account (DBT).
eligibility: All landholding farmer families (husband, wife and minor children) whose names are in the state land records. There is no upper limit on land size. e-KYC is mandatory.
exclusions: Institutional landholders; families where any member holds or held a constitutional post, is a serving or retired government employee (except Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D), pays income tax, or receives a monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more; registered doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects in practice.
how_to_apply: Register on pmkisan.gov.in under 'New Farmer Registration', or at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), or through the village Patwari / Revenue Officer. Complete e-KYC by OTP, at a CSC, or by face authentication in the PM-KISAN app.

sms_summary.en-IN: PM-KISAN: Rs 6000/yr in 3 instalments of Rs 2000 to landholding farmers. Docs: Aadhaar, land record, bank a/c, eKYC. pmkisan.gov.in Help: 155261
sms_summary.hi-IN: पीएम-किसान: भूमिधारक किसान परिवार को ₹6000/वर्ष, 3 किस्तों में। दस्तावेज़: आधार, भूमि रिकॉर्ड, बैंक खाता, eKYC। pmkisan.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 155261
sms_summary.mr-IN: पीएम-किसान: जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंबाला ₹6000/वर्ष, 3 हप्त्यांत. कागदपत्रे: आधार, सातबारा, बँक खाते, eKYC. pmkisan.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 155261
sms_summary.ta-IN: பிஎம்-கிசான்: நில உரிமை விவசாய குடும்பத்திற்கு ஆண்டுக்கு ₹6000, 3 தவணைகளில். ஆவணங்கள்: ஆதார், நில பதிவு, வங்கி கணக்கு. pmkisan.gov.in உதவி: 155261

name_en: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
benefits: Crop insurance against loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases, from sowing to post-harvest. Farmer premium is capped at 2% of the sum insured for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops; the government pays the rest.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers. Enrolment is voluntary for all farmers, including loanee farmers.
exclusions: Crops or areas not notified by the state for the season; losses from war, nuclear risks or deliberate damage.
documents: Land record or tenancy / sharecropping agreement
how_to_apply: Enrol before the seasonal cut-off date through your bank (loanee farmers), a Common Service Centre, an insurance company agent, or online at pmfby.gov.in. Report crop loss within 72 hours on the Crop Insurance app or helpline.

sms_summary.en-IN: PMFBY crop insurance: farmer premium 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial crops. Docs: Aadhaar, land/sowing record, bank a/c. pmfby.gov.in Help: 14447
sms_summary.hi-IN: फसल बीमा PMFBY: किसान प्रीमियम खरीफ 2%, रबी 1.5%, व्यावसायिक फसल 5%। दस्तावेज़: आधार, भूमि/बुवाई प्रमाण, बैंक खाता। pmfby.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 14447
sms_summary.mr-IN: पीक विमा PMFBY: शेतकरी हप्ता खरीप 2%, रब्बी 1.5%, व्यावसायिक पिके 5%. कागदपत्रे: आधार, सातबारा/पेरणी दाखला, बँक खाते. pmfby.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 14447
sms_summary.ta-IN: பயிர் காப்பீடு PMFBY: விவசாயி பிரீமியம் காரிஃப் 2%, ரபி 1.5%, வணிக பயிர் 5%. ஆவணங்கள்: ஆதார், நில/விதைப்பு பதிவு, வங்கி கணக்கு. pmfby.gov.in உதவி: 14447

benefits: Short-term crop loan and working capital from banks. With interest subvention, loans up to Rs 3 lakh carry 7% interest, reduced to an effective 4% when repaid on time. Loans up to Rs 2 lakh need no collateral. Also covers animal husbandry and fisheries.
eligibility: Owner-cultivator farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers, and self-help or joint liability groups of farmers. Also fish farmers and animal husbandry farmers. Age 18 to 75 years (a co-borrower is needed above 60).
exclusions: Persons not engaged in agriculture, animal husbandry or fisheries; existing wilful defaulters with the bank.
how_to_apply: Fill the one-page KCC form (downloadable on pmkisan.gov.in) and submit it at any commercial, cooperative or regional rural bank branch. PM-KISAN beneficiaries get simplified processing.

sms_summary.en-IN: Kisan Credit Card: crop loan up to Rs 3 lakh, 4% interest on timely repayment. Docs: Aadhaar, land record, photo. Bank or pmkisan.gov.in Help: 1800-180-1551
sms_summary.hi-IN: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड: ₹3 लाख तक फसल ऋण, समय पर चुकाने पर 4% ब्याज। दस्तावेज़: आधार, भूमि रिकॉर्ड, फोटो। बैंक या pmkisan.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-180-1551
sms_summary.mr-IN: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड: ₹3 लाखांपर्यंत पीक कर्ज, वेळेवर फेड केल्यास 4% व्याज. कागदपत्रे: आधार, सातबारा, फोटो. बँक किंवा pmkisan.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-180-1551
sms_summary.ta-IN: கிசான் கடன் அட்டை: ₹3 லட்சம் வரை பயிர் கடன், சரியான நேரத்தில் செலுத்தினால் 4% வட்டி. ஆதார், நில பதிவு. வங்கி/pmkisan.gov.in உதவி: 1800-180-1551

benefits: Free soil testing of your field and a Soil Health Card showing 12 soil parameters (N, P, K, organic carbon, pH, micronutrients and others) with crop-wise fertiliser and manure recommendations. Reduces input cost by avoiding excess fertiliser.
eligibility: All farmers. Soil samples are collected from farm plots by the agriculture department; cards are issued per plot.
how_to_apply: Contact the village agriculture extension officer, Krishi Vigyan Kendra or soil testing lab, or register on soilhealth.dac.gov.in. Download the card from the portal or the Soil Health Card app.

sms_summary.en-IN: Soil Health Card: free soil test of your field with fertiliser advice. Docs: Aadhaar, plot details. soilhealth.dac.gov.in Help: 1800-180-1551
sms_summary.hi-IN: मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड: खेत की मिट्टी की मुफ्त जांच और खाद की सलाह। दस्तावेज़: आधार, खेत का विवरण। soilhealth.dac.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-180-1551
sms_summary.mr-IN: मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिका: शेतातील मातीची मोफत तपासणी व खताचा सल्ला. कागदपत्रे: आधार, शेताचा तपशील. soilhealth.dac.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-180-1551
sms_summary.ta-IN: மண் வள அட்டை: உங்கள் வயல் மண்ணுக்கு இலவச பரிசோதனை, உர ஆலோசனை. ஆவணங்கள்: ஆதார், நில விவரம். soilhealth.dac.gov.in உதவி: 1800-180-1551

name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
name_mr: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
name_ta: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் பிரதமர் மக்கள் ஆரோக்கியத் திட்டம்
benefits: Free (cashless) hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care at empanelled government and private hospitals, including 3 days before and 15 days after hospitalisation. No limit on family size or age.
eligibility: Poor and vulnerable families identified by SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and state-added lists (often linked to ration cards). Since October 2024 all senior citizens aged 70 and above are also covered irrespective of income (Ayushman Vay Vandana card).
exclusions: Families not in the SECC / state beneficiary list (except senior citizens 70+). Outpatient (OPD) care is not covered.
documents: PM-JAY letter or family ID if available
how_to_apply: Check eligibility and create the Ayushman card at beneficiary.nha.gov.in, in the Ayushman app, at a CSC, or at the Ayushman Mitra desk of any empanelled hospital.

sms_summary.en-IN: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: free hospital care up to Rs 5 lakh/family/yr at empanelled hospitals. Docs: Aadhaar, ration card. pmjay.gov.in Help: 14555
sms_summary.hi-IN: आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY: सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख/वर्ष तक मुफ्त इलाज। दस्तावेज़: आधार, राशन कार्ड। pmjay.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 14555
sms_summary.mr-IN: आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY: यादीतील रुग्णालयांत प्रति कुटुंब ₹5 लाख/वर्ष पर्यंत मोफत उपचार. कागदपत्रे: आधार, रेशन कार्ड. pmjay.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 14555
sms_summary.ta-IN: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத்: பட்டியல் மருத்துவமனைகளில் குடும்பத்துக்கு ஆண்டுக்கு ₹5 லட்சம் வரை இலவச சிகிச்சை. ஆதார், ரேஷன் அட்டை. pmjay.gov.in உதவி: 14555

benefits: Cash assistance for delivery in a government or accredited private health facility. Rural areas: Rs 1,400 to the mother and Rs 600 to the ASHA in Low Performing States (LPS); Rs 700 to the mother and Rs 600 to the ASHA in High Performing States (HPS). Urban areas: Rs 1,000 (LPS) or Rs 600 (HPS) to the mother. Paid by DBT to the mother's bank account.
eligibility: In LPS states (UP, Uttarakhand, Bihar, Jharkhand, MP, Chhattisgarh, Assam, Rajasthan, Odisha, J&K): all pregnant women delivering in a government or accredited facility. In HPS states (all others, including Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu): pregnant women from BPL, SC or ST households.
exclusions: Deliveries in non-accredited private hospitals; in HPS states, women not from BPL / SC / ST households.
documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card / JSY card
how_to_apply: Register the pregnancy with the ASHA or ANM at the sub-centre / PHC (early registration, ideally within 12 weeks). The ASHA fills the JSY form; payment is made after institutional delivery.

sms_summary.en-IN: JSY: cash for delivery in govt hospital. Rural mother Rs 1400 (LPS states) or Rs 700 (HPS, BPL/SC/ST). Docs: MCP card, Aadhaar, bank. nhm.gov.in Help: 104
sms_summary.hi-IN: जननी सुरक्षा योजना: सरकारी अस्पताल में प्रसव पर ग्रामीण मां को ₹1400 (LPS राज्य) या ₹700 (HPS)। दस्तावेज़: MCP कार्ड, आधार, बैंक। nhm.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 104
sms_summary.mr-IN: जननी सुरक्षा योजना: सरकारी रुग्णालयात प्रसूतीसाठी ग्रामीण मातेला ₹1400 (LPS राज्ये) किंवा ₹700 (HPS). कागदपत्रे: MCP कार्ड, आधार, बँक. nhm.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 104
sms_summary.ta-IN: ஜனனி சுரக்ஷா: அரசு மருத்துவமனை பிரசவத்துக்கு கிராமப்புற தாய்க்கு ₹700 (HPS மாநிலம்) / ₹1400 (LPS). MCP அட்டை, ஆதார், வங்கி. nhm.gov.in உதவி: 104

benefits: Rs 5,000 for the first child in two instalments (Rs 3,000 after pregnancy registration and at least one antenatal check-up within 6 months; Rs 2,000 after birth registration and the first cycle of vaccination). Rs 6,000 in one instalment if the second child is a girl. Paid by DBT.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19 or above, from households meeting at least one criterion: SC/ST, BPL ration card, PM-JAY card, e-Shram card, MGNREGA job card, KCC farmer woman, women with 40% or more disability, ANM / ASHA / Anganwadi worker, or net family income below Rs 8 lakh per year.
exclusions: Women in regular employment with central or state government or PSUs, or receiving similar maternity benefit under any law.
documents: MCP card (with LMP date and ANC record)
Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account
Proof of one eligibility criterion (BPL / caste / job card / income)
how_to_apply: Register through the Anganwadi worker or ASHA, or online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in (citizen login). Register within 270 days of the last menstrual period for the first instalment. Helpline: 1515 (Mission Shakti / PMMVY toll-free; the earlier number was 14408).

sms_summary.en-IN: PMMVY: Rs 5000 for 1st child in 2 instalments; Rs 6000 if 2nd child is a girl. Women 19+. Docs: Aadhaar, MCP card, bank. pmmvy.wcd.gov.in Help: 1515
sms_summary.hi-IN: मातृ वंदना योजना: पहले बच्चे पर ₹5000 (2 किस्त), दूसरी संतान बेटी हो तो ₹6000। दस्तावेज़: आधार, MCP कार्ड, बैंक खाता। pmmvy.wcd.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1515
sms_summary.mr-IN: मातृ वंदना योजना: पहिल्या अपत्यासाठी ₹5000 (2 हप्ते), दुसरी मुलगी झाल्यास ₹6000. कागदपत्रे: आधार, MCP कार्ड, बँक खाते. pmmvy.wcd.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1515
sms_summary.ta-IN: மாத்ரு வந்தனா: முதல் குழந்தைக்கு ₹5000 (2 தவணை), 2வது பெண் குழந்தைக்கு ₹6000. ஆவணங்கள்: ஆதார், MCP அட்டை, வங்கி. pmmvy.wcd.gov.in உதவி: 1515

name_en: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
name_hi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना (मनरेगा)
name_mr: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार हमी योजना (मनरेगा)
name_ta: மகாத்மா காந்தி தேசிய ஊரக வேலை உறுதித் திட்டம் (100 நாள் வேலை)
benefits: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household per financial year for unskilled manual work, at the state-notified wage rate, paid to the bank account. Work within 5 km of the village; if work is not given within 15 days of the application, an unemployment allowance is payable.
eligibility: Any adult member (18 years or above) of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work, holding a job card issued by the Gram Panchayat.
how_to_apply: Apply for a job card at the Gram Panchayat (free, issued within 15 days). Then give a written or oral application for work to the Gram Panchayat and take a dated receipt.

sms_summary.en-IN: MGNREGA: 100 days of paid work per rural household per year, given within 15 days of asking. Docs: job card, Aadhaar, bank. nrega.nic.in Help: 1800-111-555
sms_summary.hi-IN: मनरेगा: हर ग्रामीण परिवार को साल में 100 दिन मज़दूरी वाला काम, मांगने के 15 दिन में। दस्तावेज़: जॉब कार्ड, आधार, बैंक खाता। nrega.nic.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-111-555
sms_summary.mr-IN: मनरेगा: प्रत्येक ग्रामीण कुटुंबाला वर्षात 100 दिवस मजुरीचे काम, मागणीनंतर 15 दिवसांत. कागदपत्रे: जॉब कार्ड, आधार, बँक खाते. nrega.nic.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-111-555
sms_summary.ta-IN: 100 நாள் வேலை (MGNREGA): கிராம குடும்பத்துக்கு ஆண்டுக்கு 100 நாள் ஊதிய வேலை, கேட்ட 15 நாளில். வேலை அட்டை, ஆதார், வங்கி. nrega.nic.in உதவி: 1800-111-555

benefits: A deposit-free LPG connection in the name of the woman of the household, with the first refill and a stove free of cost under Ujjwala 2.0. A targeted subsidy of Rs 300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills a year.
eligibility: An adult woman (18 years or above) from a poor household: SECC 2011 list, SC/ST, PMAY-Gramin beneficiary, Antyodaya Anna Yojana, forest dweller, most backward class, tea garden or island household, or a poor household declared under the 14-point declaration. No existing LPG connection in the household.
exclusions: Households that already have an LPG connection in any member's name.
documents: Ration card / document showing family composition
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or at the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharat Gas or HP Gas) with the KYC documents.

sms_summary.en-IN: PM Ujjwala: free LPG connection, 1st refill and stove for poor-household women 18+; Rs 300/refill subsidy. Aadhaar, ration card. pmuy.gov.in Help: 1800-233-3555
sms_summary.hi-IN: उज्ज्वला: गरीब परिवार की 18+ महिला को मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन, पहला सिलेंडर व चूल्हा; ₹300/सिलेंडर सब्सिडी। आधार, राशन कार्ड। pmuy.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-233-3555
sms_summary.mr-IN: उज्ज्वला योजना: गरीब कुटुंबातील 18+ महिलेला मोफत LPG जोडणी, पहिला सिलिंडर व शेगडी; ₹300/सिलिंडर अनुदान. आधार, रेशन कार्ड. pmuy.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-233-3555
sms_summary.ta-IN: உஜ்வாலா: ஏழை குடும்ப 18+ பெண்களுக்கு இலவச LPG இணைப்பு, முதல் சிலிண்டர், அடுப்பு; ₹300 மானியம். ஆதார், ரேஷன் அட்டை. pmuy.gov.in உதவி: 1800-233-3555

benefits: Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly, difficult and NE areas to build a pucca house of at least 25 sq m, paid in instalments to the bank account. Plus 90-95 days of MGNREGA wages and Rs 12,000 for a toilet under Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin.
eligibility: Rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha or dilapidated houses, identified through SECC 2011 / Awaas+ survey and verified by the Gram Sabha.
exclusions: Households with a pucca house; a motorised vehicle or mechanised farm equipment; a KCC limit of Rs 50,000 or more; a government employee member; a member earning more than Rs 15,000 per month; income tax payers.
how_to_apply: Beneficiaries are selected from the Awaas+ / SECC list and approved by the Gram Sabha. Contact the Gram Panchayat or Block office to check your name; track status on pmayg.nic.in.

sms_summary.en-IN: PMAY-Gramin: Rs 1.20 lakh (Rs 1.30 lakh hilly areas) to build a pucca house for houseless/kutcha house families. Aadhaar. pmayg.nic.in Help: 1800-11-6446
sms_summary.hi-IN: आवास योजना-ग्रामीण: बेघर/कच्चे घर वाले परिवार को पक्का घर बनाने हेतु ₹1.20 लाख (पहाड़ी क्षेत्र ₹1.30 लाख)। आधार, जॉब कार्ड। pmayg.nic.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-11-6446
sms_summary.mr-IN: आवास योजना-ग्रामीण: बेघर/कच्च्या घरातील कुटुंबाला पक्के घर बांधण्यासाठी ₹1.20 लाख (डोंगरी भाग ₹1.30 लाख). आधार, जॉब कार्ड. pmayg.nic.in हेल्पलाइन: 1800-11-6446
sms_summary.ta-IN: வீட்டு வசதி-கிராமம்: வீடில்லா/குடிசை குடும்பத்துக்கு கான்கிரீட் வீடு கட்ட ₹1.20 லட்சம் (மலைப்பகுதி ₹1.30 லட்சம்). ஆதார். pmayg.nic.in உதவி: 1800-11-6446

benefits: One online window to apply for central, state and UGC/AICTE scholarships (pre-matric, post-matric, merit-cum-means, top class and girls' scholarships). Money is paid by DBT to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibility: Students from Class 1 to PhD, depending on the scholarship. Most need-based scholarships have a family income limit (commonly Rs 1 lakh to Rs 2.5 lakh per year for SC/ST/OBC/minority schemes) and a minimum mark in the previous exam.
exclusions: Students already receiving another central scholarship for the same course; family income above the limit of the chosen scheme.
how_to_apply: Do One Time Registration (OTR) on scholarships.gov.in or the NSP OTR app with Aadhaar and mobile OTP, then log in and fill the application for the scheme you are eligible for before the deadline (usually October-November). The institute and district verify it.

sms_summary.en-IN: National Scholarship Portal: apply for central & state scholarships in one place. Aadhaar, income/caste cert, marksheet. scholarships.gov.in Help: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.hi-IN: राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल: केंद्र व राज्य छात्रवृत्ति के लिए एक जगह आवेदन। आधार, आय/जाति प्रमाणपत्र, अंकपत्र। scholarships.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.mr-IN: राष्ट्रीय शिष्यवृत्ती पोर्टल: केंद्र व राज्य शिष्यवृत्तींसाठी एकाच ठिकाणी अर्ज. आधार, उत्पन्न/जात दाखला, गुणपत्रक. scholarships.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.ta-IN: தேசிய உதவித்தொகை இணையதளம்: மத்திய, மாநில உதவித்தொகைக்கு ஒரே இடத்தில் விண்ணப்பம். ஆதார், வருமான/சாதி சான்று. scholarships.gov.in உதவி: 0120-6619540

benefits: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India: pre-matric scholarship for Classes 9-10, post-matric scholarship for Class 11 onwards, and Top Class School / College scholarships covering full tuition and living expenses for students in notified top institutions.
eligibility: Students from OBC, Economically Backward Class (EBC) and De-notified / Nomadic Tribe (DNT) communities with annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh, studying in a recognised school or college.
exclusions: Students from other social categories; family income above Rs 2.5 lakh per year; students getting another central scholarship for the same course.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) after One Time Registration; choose the PM YASASVI component for your class.

sms_summary.en-IN: PM YASASVI: scholarship for OBC, EBC, DNT students, family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh/yr. Apply on NSP. scholarships.gov.in Help: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.hi-IN: पीएम यशस्वी: OBC, EBC, DNT छात्रों को छात्रवृत्ति, पारिवारिक आय ₹2.5 लाख/वर्ष तक। NSP पर आवेदन। scholarships.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.mr-IN: पीएम यशस्वी: OBC, EBC, DNT विद्यार्थ्यांना शिष्यवृत्ती, कौटुंबिक उत्पन्न ₹2.5 लाख/वर्षपर्यंत. NSP वर अर्ज. scholarships.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.ta-IN: பிஎம் யசஸ்வி: OBC, EBC, DNT மாணவர்களுக்கு உதவித்தொகை, குடும்ப வருமானம் ₹2.5 லட்சம் வரை. NSP-ல் விண்ணப்பம். scholarships.gov.in உதவி: 0120-6619540

benefits: Rs 50,000 per year for every year of study (up to 4 years for degree, 3 years for diploma; 3 and 2 years for lateral entry) to meet fees, books, equipment and other costs. About 5,000 scholarships each year (2,500 degree and 2,500 diploma).
eligibility: Girl students admitted to the first year (or second year by lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved degree or diploma course. Annual family income up to Rs 8 lakh. Maximum two girls per family.
exclusions: Boys; students in non-AICTE courses; family income above Rs 8 lakh per year.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under the AICTE Pragati scheme after One Time Registration; the institute verifies the application.

sms_summary.en-IN: AICTE Pragati: Rs 50,000/yr for girls in AICTE degree/diploma courses, family income up to Rs 8 lakh. Apply on NSP. scholarships.gov.in Help: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.hi-IN: AICTE प्रगति: AICTE डिग्री/डिप्लोमा की छात्राओं को ₹50,000/वर्ष, पारिवारिक आय ₹8 लाख तक। NSP पर आवेदन। scholarships.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.mr-IN: AICTE प्रगती: AICTE पदवी/पदविका शिकणाऱ्या मुलींना ₹50,000/वर्ष, कौटुंबिक उत्पन्न ₹8 लाखांपर्यंत. NSP वर अर्ज. scholarships.gov.in हेल्पलाइन: 0120-6619540
sms_summary.ta-IN: AICTE பிரகதி: பட்டம்/டிப்ளமோ மாணவிகளுக்கு ஆண்டுக்கு ₹50,000, குடும்ப வருமானம் ₹8 லட்சம் வரை. NSP-ல் விண்ணப்பம். scholarships.gov.in உதவி: 0120-6619540
